title: Verify powerful-brain gap discovery creates executable roadmap work end to end
goal: Exercise production audit/event ingress, strongest-working-cloud selection, evidence collection, structured proposal validation, deduplication and task queue publication in an offline temporary repository. Seed a real observable capability gap and show the brain creates one actionable roadmap-linked task with correct dependency and nonzero acceptance that fails before repair and passes after repair. Repeat discovery to prove no duplicate; close related work while leaving a residual mastery gap to prove follow-up creation. Include fabricated gap rejection, invalid commands, concurrent discovery, brain outage/fallback, privacy redaction and budget limits. Assert actual new queue records, not merely generated task text, and never claim the capability improved simply because a task was added. Implement nonzero tests named brain_gap_e2e_* exercising production wiring.
